entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you with an agent.
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return something.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah, how can I assist you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's not working right.
I understand. Can you provide me with your order number please?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order… Okay, I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse. What seems to be the issue with your smart watch?
It keeps disconnecting from my phone and the heart rate monitor is wildly inaccurate. I only bought it like two weeks ago!

I apologize for the inconvenience, sir. I understand your frustration. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. So, we can definitely process a return for your VeloBand Pulse.
90 days? Okay, good. I was worried there for a second. So, what do I need to do?

I can email you a prepaid shipping label. Just repackage the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging if possible and send it back. Once we receive it, we'll process the refund back to your original payment method.
Alright, that sounds easy enough. Email me the label.
Certainly. Could you please confirm the email address associated with your account?
It's john.doe@email.com
Perfect. The shipping label has been sent to john.doe@email.com. You should receive it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks.
You're welcome! Have a great day and thank you for choosing VeloFit.

Wait a minute! I just checked the fine print online, and it says something about a 10 days return window for the VeloBand Pulse! You said 90 days. What is going on here? I need to speak to your manager!
Sir, I apologize for the confusion. I can assure you that I quoted the standard policy. I am showing a 90 day return period is valid.
No, that's not right! The website clearly states 10 days for this specific item. I want to talk to someone who knows what they're doing! This is ridiculous!

I understand your frustration, sir. I am showing the return as compliant and approved and I have already emailed you the label. As you can imagine, our manager is not available at this moment but I can request that they call you back?
Ugh, forget it! This whole thing is a waste of time! *click*
